summary: Iter 280 — Frontend e2e validation of new P1 'Trajets médicaux dédiés' on SB Drive Access. ALL 5 UI scenarios PASS. (T1) PMR user paul.vendeur@example.com logs in via /login → 'Email & mot de passe' → /login/email, lands on /access ; the landing card 'Trajet médical' (access-medical-entry) is visible. Clicking it calls startMedicalFlow which sets tripType='medical', recurrence='' and step=0 (étape Besoins). (T2) On step 0 Besoins, selecting need-card-wheelchair_manual works ; stepper-next-btn → step 1 Assistance ; stepper-next-btn → step 2 Trajet. On step 2 the 'Type de trajet' shows trip-type-medical with aria-pressed='true' (preselected as expected from startMedicalFlow) and the red-bordered 'Détails du trajet médical' card (access-medical-details) is visible. (T3) Selecting medical-reason-Dialyse, filling medical-appointment-time='2026-02-15T10:30', checking medical-round-trip → medical-return-options appears containing both medical-return-wait + medical-return-scheduled buttons. Clicking medical-return-scheduled reveals medical-return-time input which was filled with '16:00'. (T4) Google Places autocomplete on access-pickup and access-dropoff works: typed '10 Rue de Rivoli, Paris' and 'Hopital Saint-Louis, Paris', .pac-item suggestions appeared within 8s, first suggestion clicked successfully producing addresses '10 Rue de Rivoli, 75004 Paris' and 'Hôpital Saint-Louis, 75010 Paris'. stepper-next-btn → step 3 Vehicle. accessAPI.match returned 3 categories (access_standard / access_pmr / access_van) ; selected vehicle-choice-access_standard, clicked access-confirm-btn. (T5) access-confirmation visible. The medical-confirmation block renders 3 rows: 'Motif médical: Dialyse', 'Rendez-vous: 2026-02-15 à 10:30', 'Retour: Programmé à 16:00' — exactly matching the input. certified-driver-card present (Ahmed Diallo · Certifié Access) and ai-match-reasons line reads '✨ Attribution intelligente : À 0.6 km · Note 4.7★ · 7 trajet(s) adapté(s) réalisé(s) · En ligne' — required prefix '✨ Attribution intelligente :' present and distance/rating/trips/online reasons all populated. End-to-end medical booking flow with smart matching is fully wired.
critical_code_review_comments: SbAccessPage.js startMedicalFlow (line 151) correctly resets step=0 + sets tripType='medical' + clears recurrence — guarantees the medical detail card is gated by tripType when reaching step 2. Good UX.
SbAccessPage.js line 614: medical-return-time is rendered inside the medical-return-options grid with col-span-2 — works but visually couples it to the scheduled button. Acceptable.

submit() (line 203-216) correctly forwards medical payload only when tripType==='medical' and forwards scheduled_at from medical.appointment_time. Aligns with backend _build_and_store_booking expectations from review_request.

medical-confirmation block (line 691-697) renders rows conditionally (reason / appointment_time / round_trip / prescription_url) — clean fallback when prescription is omitted (the test did NOT upload a justificatif per problem-statement note, and the row was correctly absent without breaking the layout).

medical.appointment_time is a datetime-local string sent verbatim and rendered with .replace('T',' à ') — works for FR display. Consider full FR date formatting (Intl.DateTimeFormat('fr-FR')) for richer 'samedi 15 février 2026 à 10h30' display in future iterations.
The medical-reason buttons use a flex-wrap container without keyboard arrow navigation — fine for mobile-tap usage, but a11y could improve by adding role='radiogroup' for assistive tech.

ai-match-reasons line is gated only on match_reasons.length > 0 (line 715), so it gracefully hides when no certified driver matched — verified the certified driver IS matched for this PMR user (Ahmed Diallo, score-bearing match) and the line is rendered with the required ✨ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 new access booking (medical, Dialyse, 2026-02-15 10:30, round_trip=scheduled return 16:00, pickup 10 Rue de Rivoli Paris 75004, dropoff Hôpital Saint-Louis 75010, vehicle=access_standard 8.80€). Matched chauffeur Ahmed Diallo, AI score with reasons 'À 0.6 km · Note 4.7★ · 7 trajet(s) adapté(s) réalisé(s) · En ligne' — note that the adapted-trips counter incremented from 5 (iter278) to 7, confirming previous bookings are accruing. Booking remains in paul's history (not cleaned up — kept for next regression).
context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 'Trajets médicaux' fully working end-to-end. Login flow: /login → 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' → 'Email & mot de passe' → /login/email → fill + submit (lands on /home, then navigate to /access). Mobile viewport 430x900. The Google Places autocomplete is reliable when typing with delay=80ms then waiting for .pac-item then click — works for both access-pickup and access-dropoff with addresses like '10 Rue de Rivoli, Paris' and 'Hopital Saint-Louis, Paris'. The justificatif upload (medical-rx-input) is optional and was deliberately skipped — the medical-confirmation block correctly omits the 'Justificatif' row when not provided. After clicking access-medical-entry, you land on step 0 (Besoins), so you must navigate Besoins → Assistance → Trajet (2 next clicks) to reach the medical details panel. trip-type-medical aria-pressed='true' on arrival at step 2 (no manual toggle needed). All other previous-iter context (admin AI tab, SOS center, certified drivers) remains valid.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Full medical booking happy-path validated end-to-end (UI + Google Places autocomplete + backend medical persistence via accessAPI.createBooking + AI-driven certified-driver match with reasons).
